summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the admission of 3,112 ordinary shares to trading on the London Stock Exchange, issued upon exercise of options under the Prudential Sharesave Plan 2023. The shares are fungible with existing shares and were admitted on 20 May 2026. No price, premium, or consideration is involved; this is a routine equity issuance under employee share plans. There is no special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing is a standard notification of admission of further securities and does not constitute a special-situations event.
